blocks.text: 🪝 VYOMA Innovation Challenge Launched for Offline & Multilingual Voice AI Solutions. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: DIBD MeitY partners with Current AI and Kalpa Impact to offer up to ₹80 lakh in prizes.
Challenge Mandate: Encourages open-source, voice-first AI solutions operating in low-connectivity environments.
Reference Device: Builds on 'Sunno Sutra', an open-source handheld AI device unveiled at IndiaAI Impact Summit 2026.
Developer Support: 20 shortlisted teams receive developer kits and mentorship.
⚠️ **Regulatory Compliance Trap:** Ensure exact compliance dates, institutional ceilings, and penalty provisions are verified during recall.
🎯 Exam Angle → Focus on global publishing body, India ranking/score movement, top-ranked country, and underlying evaluation indicators.
